observations: Photo 0 shows two Panasonic dry irons, one cream and one pink, with visible scuffs, chipped paint, and worn fabric-setting labels; both have attached cords and plugs.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of a metallic soleplate with a pink edge and a small white tag marked MAY, resting on a wooden surface.
Photo 2 shows a black Gold-branded dry iron with a UK three-pin plug and braided cord, with visible wear on the body and control label.
No photo shows any iron switched on, heating, or producing steam.

claims.evidence: Photos show standard household dry irons, not industrial pressing equipment.
Subjective description; photos show used household irons with no heavy-duty markings.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 show electric cords and plugs.
Photos show scuffs, scratches, and wear on all irons.

risks.risk: Heating element or thermostat may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the iron switched on and reaching heat.

risks.risk: Power cord or plug may be damaged or unsafe.
risks.proof: Close-up of the full cord and plug, including insulation and pins.
risks.if_unproven: as needing cord or plug replacement.

risks.risk: Soleplate may be scratched, stained, or detached.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the soleplate surface for each iron.

risks.risk: The photos may show multiple irons or parts rather than one machine.
risks.proof: A single shot showing all items together or seller confirmation of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single dry iron.

proof_requests: Video of each iron switched on and heating.
Close-up of the plug and full length of each cord.
Confirmation whether the photo 1 soleplate is attached to an iron or sold separately.
Clear shot showing all items included in the sale.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used electric dry iron; even with unreadable models and multiple brands shown, it can be priced at its worst case as non-working.
